text: City Council has authorized the City Clerk to shortlist, interview and recommend candidates to Community Councils for appointment to the Larry Grossman Forest Hill Memorial Arena Board. This report recommends three candidates for appointment to the board.

City Council on May 5 and 6, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council waive the two-term limit provision of the Public Appointments Policy and appoint the following candidate to the Larry Grossman Forest Hill Memorial Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending April 20, 2023, and until a successor is appointed: Neil Linden
